model.title: Data model
model.intro: The things your backend stores, such as posts, customers or orders, and how they connect.

history.title: Change history
history.intro: Records who changed which fields of a record, and what the old and new values were, for as long as you choose to keep them.
history.emptyDetail: Pick an entity and select the fields whose changes you want to keep.
history.all: Every entity already has a history config.
history.selectField: Select at least one field to record.
history.removeProtected: Deselect secret fields and fields already recorded in state history.
history.enterDays: Enter how many days to keep changes.
history.retentionHint: 1 to 3650 days. Older changes are purged. Recorded values over 4096 bytes are shortened.
history.rolesHint: With no roles selected, the generated API leaves out the history route.
history.secretField: Looks like a secret. Secrets are never recorded.
history.stateField: This field is already logged in the state history.
history.removeDetail: Saving this change removes history tracking for {{entity}}.

machines.title: State machines
machines.intro: How a record moves between states, who can move it, and what must be true first.
machines.emptyDetail: A state machine needs an entity with a required enum field.
machines.removeDetail: Saving this change removes the state machine and its transitions for {{entity}}.
machines.initialRequired: Set a valid default on the enum field in the data model. It becomes the initial state.
machines.incompatible: The selected enum must include the states used by your transitions.
machines.pickTransition: Select a transition in the diagram or list to see its guard, roles and trigger.
machines.removeTransitionDetail: Saving this change removes the {{name}} transition.
machines.duplicateTransition: This transition name is already in use.
machines.fromRequired: Select at least one state to move from.
machines.anyEditor: Anyone who may update the record
machines.guardOk: The expression returns true or false.
machines.guardFailed: Check that the guard returns true or false.

permissions.noChanges: The draft does not change effective access.

timeline.intro: Every change to the project spec, who made it and when.

timeline.undoDetail: Take back the last change and record the undo in the timeline.
timeline.redoDetail: Apply the last change you undid.
